purpose: Coverage registry for authorized Paper/Spigot/Purpur/Folia server -> native mod conversion. It is a detection/triage registry, not a redistribution license.
coverage_rule: Known entries improve automatic classification; unknown plugin JAR/config folders are still inventoried and surfaced. Integration-hub and legacy aliases are included so 2026 and older server captures do not silently lose behavior.
